meta.name: polyact observation 1.4.1
meta.description: The polyact 1.4.1 observation contract: 1280 float32 input slots in ten blocks (A context, B ego, C boundary, D objective, E field, F action_history, G progress, I directive, J gravity, H reserved), every slot labelled with its channel, frame offset, transform and meaning. Stacked in index order so the canvas numbers them 0–1279. Encoders, trunk and head are placeholders — the brain's internal architecture is out of scope for the input document.

blocks.title: A · context [0–31]
blocks.comment: "what kind of body am I, in what kind of world?" — Depth 1 throughout: descriptors and slow run-level scalars. 27 declared channels, 5 reserved. Deliberately NO domain identity — a capability vector transfers to an unseen body, a one-hot domain id cannot.

regions.name: descriptors & run scalars

blocks.title: B · ego [32–117]
blocks.comment: "what is my own kinematic state?" — Proprioception in body frame (+X forward, +Y left, +Z up). The one block that is deliberately NOT generalised: slots are specifically kinematic; a domain with no pose leaves all 86 at zero. Rate-critical channels carry five log-spaced frames — that history IS the derivative term.

blocks.title: C · boundary [118–373]
blocks.comment: "how close is a limit, what kind, how fast am I approaching it?" — 32 rays × 8 channels, index = 118 + ray*8 + channel. Spatially a sphere of rangefinders (16 equatorial, 16 off-plane, no two closer than 22.5°); abstractly a (state variable, limit) margin — a bioreactor fills it with pH/DO/temperature limits using the same eight channels unmodified.

blocks.comment: "what did I already command?" — Efference copy: all 16 emitted action channels at five log-spaced offsets, index = 806 + channel*5 + frame. OFFSET 0 IS THE ACTION EMITTED ON THE PREVIOUS TICK. Actuators lag; a controller that cannot see its own outstanding commands oscillates against its own latency. Hold detection is free: a held key is the same value on consecutive frames. All 16 are filled in every domain, including channels the decoder ignores.

blocks.title: I encoder
blocks.comment: Reads block I (directive). Only the claimed, exposed regions are wired — reserved slots stay unwired, so they cost zero parameters. Width 32 is a placeholder: the brain's internal architecture is out of scope for the 1.4.1 input document.

blocks.title: J · gravity [1102–1104]
blocks.comment: "which way is down?" — Unit direction of gravitational acceleration in body frame — the vestibular / 'projected gravity' sense. Unit length where gravity is present, all bit-zero whenever block A slot 9 (gravity_present) is 0. For a domain whose nominal-up axis is body +Z, gravity_dir_z = −uprightness exactly. Depth 1: its derivative is −ω × d and ω already carries depth-5 history in block B.

1.label: gravity_dir_y

blocks.title: J encoder
blocks.comment: Reads block J (gravity). Only the claimed, exposed regions are wired — reserved slots stay unwired, so they cost zero parameters. Width 8 is a placeholder: the brain's internal architecture is out of scope for the 1.4.1 input document.

blocks.title: H · reserved [1105–1279]
blocks.comment: "growth region, zero in 1.4.1" — All exactly 0.0. The only sanctioned way to add a new sense; claiming any of it requires an RFC because a claim is permanent. Unclaimed reserve is not wired into any encoder — one float in a buffer and zero parameters — which is why this block has no outgoing wire. First proposed claims: an ambient flow field (hydrofoil), per-joint state (walker), process/sensor-health state (bioreactor). Blocks I and J are the claims that already went through this process.
